blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebuanos can expect generally fair weather on Wednesday, September 23, although isolated rains and thunderstorms may occur, the state weather bureau said. In its daily forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said localized thunderstorms would likely develop over Cebu, particularly in the afternoon and evening.
